title: Kirby Problem 3.55
exact_target: Must minus knot Floer homology of every nontrivial knot, and every nonzero reduced Floer group of a rational homology sphere, split off a one-dimensional summand annihilated by U? What geometric meaning and smaller-length summands accompany such splittings?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2853 (KP-3.55). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.55, p. 170 and following remarks; original author version.
